name: visual-recap
description: Live view of where the agent spends its time, plus a running summary timeline of the session.

showBand.title: Show band
showBand.description: Show the time strip and totals above the prompt

openPanel.title: Open panel at startup
openPanel.description: Open the recap panel when a session starts (/visual-recap opens it any time)

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Band and panel colors: default, or theme to follow your Claude Code theme

bandView.title: Band view
bandView.description: The view the band starts each session in: wall (where the time goes, one activity per second) or work (the work mix, with subagents on a second row). /visual-recap view wall|work switches it until the session ends

summaries.title: Turn summaries
summaries.description: Describe each finished turn with a one-sentence Haiku summary; the call sends the turn's prompt, its action labels and the start of the reply. Off: no model call is made, nothing is sent, and the timeline lists the turn's actions instead
